==Biography==
===2015 Season===
Lee "'''IgNar'''" Dong-geun joined [[Winterfox]] in January 2015, as a substitute for the support role. He left in May, without ever starting in a competitive match for them. A week after leaving Winterfox, he joined [[Incredible Miracle]] to replace [[TusiN]], who was moved to jungle. The team had to play in the [[Champions Summer 2015/Promotion|Champions Summer Promotion Tournament]] and they ended up qualifying for [[SBENU Champions Summer 2015]] after going 2-0 against [[Winners]] and [[Anarchy]]. IM placed ninth in the regular season of Champions Summer and were forced to play in the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Promotion|LCK 2016 Season Spring Promotion]]. Incredible Miracle played the [[Dark Wolves]] in the promotion tournament and beat them 3-1 to requalify for the LCK. 

===2016 Season===
IM competed in the [[2015 LoL KeSPA Cup]] where they lost 2-1 against the [[Jin Air Green Wings]] in the first round. IgNar left IM to join [[KT Rolster]] on December 2.  However, he only started for the team in [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season/Team Rosters|three games]] of the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season|LCK]] before departing the team in March.

Ignar then was reported to have tried out for [[TSM|TSM's]] open support position but was rejected due to insufficient English skills. He would later announce that he was joining [[Misfits Gaming]] to compete in the [[EU_Challenger_Series/2016_Season/Summer_Season|EUCS Summer Season]]. The team finished first in both the regular season and the playoffs and qualified for the [[EU LCS 2017 Spring]].

===2017 Season===
Misfits ended the spring season at 3rd place in Group A with a 8-5 score and 4th place in playoffs. In [[EU LCS 2017 Summer]], Misfits had a 6-7 score in Group A and placed 3rd in the regular split. The team then defeated [[Unicorns Of Love]] and [[Fnatic]] with two 3-0 in the playoffs, losing to [[G2 Esports]]. 

In [[Worlds 2017]], Misfits was placed in Group D, alongside [[Team WE]], [[Team SoloMid]], and [[Flash Wolves]]. The team surpassed everybody's expectations and made it out of groups stage with a 3-3 score and a tiebreaker win against TSM. In the quarterfinals, Misfits was placed against tournament favorite [[SK Telecom T1]]. The team ultimately lost with a 2-3 score but won the heart of many fans for their unconventional picks. Shortly after Worlds, Ignar announced that he would be leaving the team after the All-Stars event.

===2018 Season===
Ignar join [[LCK]] team [[bbq Olivers]] with G2's previous jungler [[Trick]]. bbq Olivers placed 8th in the [[LCK 2018 Spring]] and last in the [[LCK 2018 Summer]], with a disappointing 6-12 and 2-16 score. The team then lost both games in the [[LCK 2019 Spring Promotion]] against [[DAMWON Gaming]] and [[MVP]], resulting in bbq Olivers demoting into [[CK 2019 Spring]]. 

On November 19 2018, Ignar announced that Trick and him would be leaving the team.

===2019 Season===
Ignar returned to Europe for 2019 and joined [[FC Schalke 04 Esports]] for the first year of the newly formed LEC, along with [[Odoamne]], [[Memento]], and [[Abbedagge]]. Schalke started out the [[LEC/2019 Season/Spring Season|spring split]] strong and looked like a top contender, but collapsed in the second half of the split and finished with a 9-9 record. This forced them to play a tiebreaker with [[SK Gaming]] for the final playoff spot, which they lost, ending their season. 

Ignar remained with the team for the [[LEC/2019 Season/Summer Season|summer split]], and was reunited with his former [[bbq Olivers]] teammate [[Trick]], who joined to replace Memento. This time, Schalke had a consistent split, settling into fourth place by the third week and remaining there for the remainder of the season, finishing with an 11-7 record. In the playoffs, they defeated first [[Team Vitality]], then the surprising [[Rogue (European Team)|Rogue]], both by 3-1 scores, to earn a chance at playing in the finals, but were immediately swept by [[Fnatic]], leaving them in third place. Their regular-season performance did give Schalke the second seed in the [[LEC 2019 Regional Finals]], but they were swept by [[Splyce]], leaving Ignar short of worlds again. He then left the team in November. 

== Trivia ==
* Owns a [[wikipedia:Pomeranian_(dog)|Pomeranian]] named Holiday.
* Enjoys reading manga and watching anime.
* Enjoys playing ''[[wikipedia:en:Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos|Warcraft III]]'', ''[[wikipedia:en:Dark Souls III|Dark Souls III]]'' and ''[[wikipedia:en:Tekken 7|TEKKEN 7]]''.
* Became world famous after he beat [[SK Telecom T1]] in the [[2017 World Championship]] Quarterfinals on {{ci|Blitzcrank}} and {{ci|Leona}} with Fervor of Battle, although Misfits eventually lost the series.

=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x EU 1st All Pro Team (Spring 2017)
* 1x NA 2nd All Pro Team (Spring 2020)
* 1x NA 3rd All Pro Team (Summer 2020)
* 1x EU 3rd All Pro Team (Summer 2019)
